claims.sourceText: National Archives media alert 08-130, 'NARA to Open Official Personnel Files of the OSS', 7 August 2008, https://www.archives.gov/press/press-releases/2008/nr08-130
claims.text: The National Archives names Dulles among the OSS personnel files opened on 14 August 2008: the press office distributed CDs including 'selected files of some of the notable people who served in the OSS, including former CIA directors Allen Dulles and William Casey'.

title: National Archives media alert 08-130, NARA to Open Official Personnel Files of the OSS
